installCommand: (corepack enable || true) && corepack prepare pnpm@8.8.0 --activate && ( [ -f apps/web/pnpm-lock.yaml ] && pnpm --filter ./apps/web... install --frozen-lockfile || pnpm --filter ./apps/web... install)
buildCommand: (corepack enable || true) && corepack prepare pnpm@8.8.0 --activate && pnpm -w install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm -w exec prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter ./apps/web... build
